translated_text: 42 the Zabalion Also fforsheim 21. 12. 34 I was very happy with your letter. If we can meet in Germany, it doesn't matter to me where. I can't go to France because I don't know how I'll pay you back. I think we should meet. And depending on when we meet in Baden-Baden and the weather, we'll either continue on or stay. Just one more thing. I don't know the exact day yet, so there might be a slight postponement, so we might meet on December 30th. I'm going to Prague tomorrow, and I don't know if I'll be back in Baden-Baden on the 19th. I'm writing to you from Prague, not yet.
